test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 63 men can complete a work in 30 days. In how many days 21 men will do the same work?
solution:
**Given:-**

63 men can complete a work in 30 days

**Concept used:- **** **

Less number of men will need more days

**Calculation:-**

Let the required number of days be D.

Hence, it is an inverse proportion.

∴ 21:63::30:D

⇒ 21 × D = 63 × 30

⇒ D = (63 × 30)/21 ​

⇒ D = 90

**∴ 21 men will complete the same work in__ 90 __days.**
